title: Nobody Claps For The Quiet Hours | A Discipline Short Film
lines: 2:10 a.m. Everyone you know is asleep.
The exam is in three weeks. The doubt is in his head right now.
Nobody will clap for the hours he spends here.
That's the price. Quiet hours. Unseen work.
He reads one more page. Then another.
Morning comes. He is tired, and he does not stop.
Talent gets you started. Hours decide where you finish.
While others waited for the perfect moment,
he built it, one quiet hour at a time.
Your future is being written right now, in the hours nobody sees.
